title: Computer Vision Engineer -DSA
description:
**vConstruct**, a part of DPR Construction, is transforming the construction industry through digital engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, BIM, Data Engineering, and advanced analytics. We build AI\-powered solutions that improve productivity, safety, quality, planning, and decision\-making across the construction lifecycle.
We are looking for passionate Computer Vision Specialists who enjoy solving complex real\-world problems using deep learning, machine learning, and visual intelligence. **Role Overview**
As a Computer Vision Specialist, you will design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered vision solutions that automate and augment construction workflows. You will work closely with AI Engineers, Data Scientists, BIM experts, domain specialists, and software engineers to build scalable computer vision systems using images, videos, drone imagery, CCTV feeds, LiDAR, point clouds, and 3D data.
You will contribute across the complete AI lifecycle—from dataset creation and model development to optimization, deployment, and continuous improvement.**Key Responsibilities**
Computer Vision Development* Design and develop AI\-powered computer vision solutions for construction and engineering applications.
* Build and optimize models for image and video analytics, visual inspection, object detection, segmentation, OCR, tracking, and quality assessment.
* Collaborate with AI engineers and domain experts to deliver scalable, production\-ready vision solutions.

**AI Model Development*** Build and train CNN, Vision Transformer (ViT), DETR, YOLO, Mask R\-CNN, Segment Anything (SAM), Grounding DINO, CLIP, Florence, and related architectures.
* Fine\-tune foundation vision models.
* Apply transfer learning and self\-supervised learning techniques.
* Build multimodal AI systems combining vision and language models.

**Dataset Engineering*** Design and manage image and video datasets for computer vision applications.
* Develop annotation strategies and ensure high\-quality labeled datasets.
* Apply data augmentation, synthetic data generation, and active learning techniques to improve model performance.

**Research \& Innovation*** Evaluate latest Computer Vision research.
* Experiment with emerging vision foundation models.
* Prototype innovative AI solutions.
* Publish technical findings internally.

**Required Technical Skills*** Strong programming skills in Python with experience in AI/ML development.
* Hands\-on experience with Deep Learning and Computer Vision frameworks.
* Experience developing solutions for Object Detection, Image Classification, Segmentation, OCR, Video Analytics, and Visual Inspection.
* Experience with modern Computer Vision architectures, including CNNs, Vision Transformers, and Foundation Vision Models.
* Strong understanding of image and video data processing, model training, evaluation, and optimization.
* Experience preparing and improving datasets through annotation, augmentation, and quality validation.
* Familiarity with GPU\-based model training and inference optimization.
* Working knowledge of Vision\-Language Models (VLMs) and Multimodal AI is preferred.
* Experience integrating AI models into production applications and collaborating with software engineering teams

**Preferred Experience*** 4–8 years of Computer Vision experience.
* Experience deploying production AI solutions.
* Experience training custom deep learning models.
* Experience with GPU optimization.
* Experience handling large\-scale image/video datasets.
* Experience working in Agile product teams.

**Soft Skills:**Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, excellent communication and collaboration, ownership mindset, adaptability, continuous learning, and a passion for innovation. ￼ **Why Join vConstruct?**
At vConstruct, you'll work on AI solutions that solve real\-world construction challenges at global scale. You'll collaborate with experts in AI, BIM, digital construction, and engineering to build cutting\-edge Computer Vision systems that shape the future of construction technology. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern vision foundation models, multimodal AI, and production\-grade machine learning while creating measurable impact across one of the world's largest industries **About vConstruct :**


vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling and Construction Technology services geared towards construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction.  

VConstruct has 100\+ team members working on Software Development, Data Analytics, Data Engineering and AI/ML. We have matured Data Science practice and growing at accelerated pace. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com

DPR Construction is a national commercial general contractor and construction manager specializing in technically challenging and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, biopharmaceutical, corporate office, and higher education and healthcare markets. With the purpose of building great things, great teams, great buildings, great relationships—DPR is a truly great company. For more information, please visit www.dpr.com

* Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams.

**About Credit Risk Review (CRR)**
==================================


**Credit Risk Review** (CRR) provides independent, objective, reliable, valued, and timely assurance to the Board of Directors, Risk Committees, the Citigroup Chief Risk Officer, the Citigroup Chief Credit Officer, senior management, and global regulators. CRR evaluates the effectiveness of credit and collateral risk management, assessing the ability of business units and independent Risk Management to identify, monitor, and mitigate current and emerging credit risks.

As a key member of the **CRR Analytics Team**, you will provide critical data analytics and credit risk analyst support to Lead Reviewers. Maintain a deep understanding of credit policies and data structures to track the end\-to\-end credit lifecycle, including origination, underwriting standards, limit utilization, covenant compliance, and workout/remediation processes.

* **Reporting \& Regulatory Presentations:** Assist in preparing high\-quality presentations and reporting materials to support internal governance committees and regulatory examinations.
